## Windows x64

Download the `Emaki-Studio-Setup-*.exe` asset below and run it to install **Emaki Studio** for your account. The installer is unsigned, so Windows may show a SmartScreen warning.

Open **Emaki Studio** from the Start menu, then choose **Try the example game** to open *The Keeper of Gullwing Point*. Studio includes the project launcher, editor, and game exporters. It bundles its Node runtime. Optional sound, voice, and movie compression uses a separately installed [FFmpeg](https://ffmpeg.org/download.html).

## macOS and Linux

Use the [source setup instructions](https://github.com/AbhishekNair050/Emaki/blob/main/docs/getting-started.md) with Node.js 22.18 or newer and Git.

See the [illustrated guide](https://abhisheknair050.github.io/Emaki/) for editor and player controls.
